newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Monday amid squaring of positions on the settlement day, and dealers said sentiment would remain mixed on Tuesday.
"Some new accounts buying is expected on Tuesday but investors would remain cautious as the market lacks direction," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 1.26 points, or 0.38 percent, to end at 1,481.37. Losers and gainers stood at 130 each as turnover rose to 48.97 million shares from 41 million on Sunday.
Faysal Bank fell 0.35 to 23.80 rupees but Muslim Commercial Bank rose 0.75 to 38. Saif Textile rose 3.0 to 14. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.15 to 30.70.
Hub Power Co rose 0.15 to 35.15 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 390. PTCL fell 0.30 to 31.60. Fauji Fetilizer fell 2.0 to 77.
